description: The finding carried three mutually contradictory provenance claims for the same computation (Tesla V100, 5.1 hours; B200, 47 minutes; B200, 5.3 seconds), a SHA-256 hash for a file (data/zaremba-cf-rd-1e6.csv) that does not exist in the repository, and a footer code link pointing to an unrelated kernel (zaremba_density_gpu.cu).
action_taken: All contradictory provenance removed and replaced with a single verifiable record: count_representations_v2.c, single CPU thread, 24.7 s for d <= 10^6 (11,415,955,624 DFS nodes), with committed run log and SHA-256 of the actual committed CSV. Code links now point to the actual generator and cross-validation is described in the finding.
